title: KCF Knowledge Coverage Model v1
description: Declares, per profile, the knowledge obligations a domain model should satisfy. The grammar defines what is well-formed; this model defines what is complete.

familyPolicies.description: Explicit completeness-policy decision for each grammar construct family that has no obligation, so meta-coverage can distinguish a deliberate non-applicability from an unfinished policy. Keyed by family name; `_comment` is allowed as documentation.

exemptTraits.description: Concept traits that exempt a concept from write obligations (CRUD/set/transform); an exempt concept needs only read/query.

collections.description: For at-least-one-of: named top-level collections that satisfy the obligation when any is non-empty (alternatives to conceptKind).

section.description: For subsection-required-when-present: the cross-cutting section (e.g. security, integration) whose presence triggers the obligation.

requires.description: For subsection-required-when-present: the sub-field of `section` that must be non-empty when the section is present.

vocabularyExempt.description: When true, a vocabulary/minimal package (see is_vocabulary_package) is exempt from this obligation - it is a substantive-content or profile-anchor obligation an intentionally-sparse library need not meet.

evidence.description: What satisfies this obligation (the positive signal a reviewer/tool looks for).

exceptions.description: Documented cases exempt from this obligation.

fixtures.description: Positive/negative fixture references demonstrating the obligation firing and not firing.
